RC.Settings.ApiBaseUrl.Name: Role Call API base URL
RC.Settings.ApiBaseUrl.Hint: Role Call server origin. Leave the default unless you self-host.
RC.Settings.ApiToken.Name: Role Call API token
RC.Settings.ApiToken.Hint: Filled automatically by Connect to Role Call, or paste a token from your game's Tokens page. It identifies which game's scenes are pulled. Stored in this browser only, so it is never shared with your players — you will need to connect again on another computer.
RC.Settings.Connect.Name: Connect to Role Call
RC.Settings.Connect.Label: Connect to Role Call
RC.Settings.Connect.Hint: Link this Foundry client to a Role Call campaign — sign in (or create a free account) in your browser and the token is set up for you. No copy-paste.
RC.Settings.SyncNow.Name: Sync scenes now
RC.Settings.SyncNow.Label: Sync from Role Call
RC.Settings.SyncNow.Hint: Pull this game's scenes from Role Call into journal entries.
